desc:
🎲 ROLL troops. ⚔️ CONQUER zones. 💰 COLLECT cash!

Pull the lever and see who joins your army! Start with a rookie and build up to tanks, jets and MYTHICAL war machines.

🎲 Roll for 80+ unique troops across 6 rarities
⭐ Hunt for rare GOLDEN troops
⚔️ Battle through 35 zones and take down every boss
💰 Risk it! Clear more zones in one run for up to 6x cash
🍀 Upgrade your luck all the way

Can you build the biggest army and beat the Final Command?

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game for more updates!
🔔 Follow so you never miss new zones and troops!
